facts.text: Armenia is landlocked in the Caucasus.
Lake Sevan lies among Armenia’s mountains.

culture.text: Armenian has its own alphabet, used since the early fifth century.

food.name: Khorovats
food.text: This Armenian barbecue grills meat and often accompanies it with vegetables such as tomato and eggplant.
